description: Spec and mock tooling. Never published.

scripts.conformance:go: go -C apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/go build -o bin/driver ./conformance/driver && node toolchain/conformance/run.mjs apis/${API:-backmarket} --driver apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/go/bin/driver
scripts.conformance:csharp: dotnet build apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/csharp/conformance/Driver -c Release -f net10.0 -o apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/csharp/conformance/bin/net10.0 && node toolchain/conformance/run.mjs apis/${API:-backmarket} --driver "dotnet apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/csharp/conformance/bin/net10.0/*.Conformance.dll"
scripts.conformance:csharp:net8: dotnet build apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/csharp/conformance/Driver -c Release -f net8.0 -o apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/csharp/conformance/bin/net8.0 && node toolchain/conformance/run.mjs apis/${API:-backmarket} --driver "dotnet apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/csharp/conformance/bin/net8.0/*.Conformance.dll"
scripts.conformance:rust: cargo build --locked --manifest-path apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/rust/Cargo.toml --example conformance-driver && node toolchain/conformance/run.mjs apis/${API:-backmarket} --driver apis/${API:-backmarket}/packages/rust/target/debug/examples/conformance-driver
